bw.label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Repeated columns, spanning beams, purlins and windows exist, but the roof is a plain slab without corrugation. Representative assembly connections are not readable in the delivered hero.
Foreground conveyors, intermediate upright tank, rear raised machinery and left window wall preserve the broad organization. Overall equipment and hall proportions remain plausible.
Four machine bodies occupy a supported raised deck, but their housings read as uniform pale blocks without the required brushed stainless response in the hero.

Yellow guarding and three stairs exist, but the tank obstructs the middle stair approach and continuous front guarding blocks the left stair landing. Rail materials have no specified wear or surface variation.
Utilities are sparse smooth loops and straight pipes, without a readable reducer or crinkled foil finish. The left hanger visibly ends above its duct.
The upright tank has formed heads, feet and a top flange in the required zone. Its finish is bright, uniform green without wear, and uses the same metallic and roughness values as the floor.
Substantial blue conveyor runs have legs, rails and widely spaced rollers. The declared motor is only an isolated cuboid, without identifiable drive geometry or a readable mechanical connection.

Green reflective flooring and clear component colors are present, but the hero lacks differentiated brushed-metal and foil highlights. Illumination reads as broad fill rather than clearly dominant side-window daylight.

The elevated diagonal view preserves the principal equipment zones with natural perspective, but the overhead duct-and-process-pipe network is not jointly recognizable, and structural detail is too weak for review callouts.
The editable project opens, uses Cycles and AgX, and has no external image textures. However, denoising is disabled at scene level and the original delivered image has conspicuous noise.
The original delivery is a valid decoded PNG, but measures 512×267 instead of 3840×2160.

dimension_scores.evidence: The hall and principal equipment groups are recognizable, but machinery and utilities are substantially simplified.
Platforms and conveyors have supports, but obstructed access, disconnected hangers and weak drive connections reduce installation plausibility.
Yellow guarding, blue conveyors, green tank and dark frame provide useful separation; pale blocklike machines and faceted vessel heads lose characteristic detail.
Primitive machine housings, sparse fittings, faceting and heavy delivered noise give the scene an unfinished model appearance.
Major front-to-back and side-wall relationships remain clear, although local tank and stair spacing creates access problems.
Machines, tank, stairs and hall have broadly credible relative sizes; slender framing and widely spaced conveyor rollers weaken the industrial scale.
Floor reflections and soft shading establish volume, but metallic surfaces lack differentiation and the delivered image is visibly noisy.
All broad equipment categories are represented; dense utilities, practical connections, detailed machinery and the required hero resolution are missing.

bw.same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.

structure.structure_requirement: At least 3 nonempty finite meshes, all meshes finite and all object matrices finite
structure.group_interpretation: Structural operability only; no claim of semantic or true 3D recovery

target.rule: lexicographically first non-root EMPTY with >=2 nonstructural finite mesh descendants

approximate_relations.limitation: AABB candidates only, not true mesh contact/collision; no ground truth support labels

hierarchy_parts.meaning: Integrity of emitted part declarations; not completeness against reference image

known_support.meaning: Declared support; normalized AABB contact approximation, not true mesh support

mesh_intersection.meaning: Triangle surface crossings; intended joints may also intersect. No containment test or semantic collision truth; supplemental, not hard gate

structure.measurement_limit: AABB extents are approximate, not collision tests; unknown scale, no metric 3D accuracy

target_selection.rule: lexicographically first non-root EMPTY with >=2 nonstructural finite mesh descendants

non_target_preservation.comparison: Exact direct comparison of matrices, local vertices, material values/nodes and parent; no hashes

material.operation: Copy target mesh/materials, replace target surface with blue Principled shader

move.normalization: nonstructural scene AABB diagonal; no true metric scale

non_target_preservation.comparison: Exact direct comparison of matrices, local vertices, material values/nodes and parent; no hashes

functional.interpretation: Mechanical structure/material operation; no text editor or natural-image 3D ground truth. Support AABB approximate; optional collision crossings not full solidity truth.

evaluation_scope: seconds is current evaluation/generation invocation wall; resumed evaluation is recorded separately; see timing.csv for every process
